keySentence: She learned there is truly no place like home.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy was finally home. She learned many things. Family is the most important. She learned there is truly no place like home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Dorothy was finally back in Kansas with her loving family. She thought about her amazing adventure in the Land of Oz. Her friends taught her about brains, hearts, and courage. She learned there is truly no place like home in the world. The most important thing was the love of her family. Dorothy smiled and knew she was exactly where she belonged.
